chunks: And We shall raise a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, and cover them over so that they will not be able to see.
ai.seo_question: What does the 'barrier' (sadd) in front and behind refer to in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the concept of 'seal of the heart' (khatm al-qalb), where prolonged rejection of truth leads to a divine confirmation of their disbelief, rendering them spiritually blind. The barriers placed before and behind signify the complete closure of their perception to both the signs of creation and the reality of the Hereafter. This state is not merely physical blindness but a consequence of their own choice to remain in spiritual darkness.
